title: Systematic bias from overlapping temporal classifications requires correction in aoristic reconstructions: research compendium
description:
Research compendium for the paper “Systematic bias from overlapping temporal classifications requires correction in aoristic reconstructions” by Martin Hinz and Nils Müller-Scheeßel, prepared for submission to the Journal of Archaeological Science. It contains the manuscript, six executable Quarto supplements, the data and all code needed to reproduce the analyses.

Code is released under the MIT licence, text, figures and derived data under CC BY 4.0. Third-party data keep the licences of their providers (see README).
